description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to media pipeline capabilities, including a factory class for creating media pipeline capabilities objects and the main class 'MediaPipelineCapabilities' which provides methods to query supported MIME types and check MIME type support. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external interfaces such as IGstCapabilities and IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements IMediaPipelineCapabilities, providing methods to query media capabilities such as supported MIME types.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
